I will put fertilizer on this maize piece because it is my home land and I want food from it, but I will not be heavy with cash. I do what I have seen work here: I will use improved seed when I can get it, and I will add manure from home because bought fertilizer alone is costly. I will not spray and I will not irrigate; for maize here I wait for the rains. I am old now, so family will do most of the work and I will bring a few hired people at planting and weeding.
